requirement: WSDC prohibits virtual judging (3.4.7.d). DanceFlow reading: a declared remote-judging arrangement is "virtual judging" and fails readiness for WSDC Jack and Jill contests (the scope of 3.4.7); the organizer declaration of on-site arrangements is DanceFlow policy, not a WSDC requirement. The software cannot prove physical presence.
enforcement_point: Planned (docs/competition/governance/judging-integrity/OD-05-conflicts-design.md section 6E): judging-arrangement declaration and _compoc_blockers_judging_arrangement for the declared body. Not built.
interpretation_notes: The text read does not define virtual judging (searched virtual, remote, device, electronic); "remote = virtual" is a DanceFlow reading. Declaration is a self-attestation only. NOT IMPLEMENTED (design only, PR-A section 6E): a BLOCKER to activating this body profile; no test; no compliance claimed. A declaration is a self-attestation, never a verification.
